task_message:
Case L18: segment the lipomatous soft-tissue tumor on this T1-weighted MRI.

Volume: 201x201x356 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Case L18 is complete.

**What I found:** A well-circumscribed, T1-hyperintense (fat-intensity) intramuscular mass in the lateral compartment of the thigh — a lipomatous soft-tissue tumor measuring roughly 6.5 × 6 × 11.5 cm.

**Process:**
1. `seg_open` plus axial, coronal and sagittal contact sheets to localize the lesion and check both ends of the volume (confirming the distal ovoid structure at ~slice 250–280 was normal muscle, not tumor).
2. A 3-point positive prompt inside the mass on axial slice 188 produced a single-component mask (166 mL, axial 119–235, coronal 93–155, sagittal 110–173).
3. Verified the boundaries with zoomed mask crops at the upper (125/128), middle (210) and lower (228) levels and in coronal/sagittal reformats — the green contour followed the lesion capsule and the fat–muscle interface.
4. Reviewed the automatic candidates (C1–C3); all were subcutaneous/intermuscular fat adjacent to the capsule, so none were accepted.
5. Final review confirmed no lesion tissue past either pole (axi 111 and axi 243 clean, cor 85/163 and sag 102/181 clean) and a single component.

Final mask saved at 166.0 mL with medium confidence (boundary clear; slight uncertainty only at the tapered poles where tumor fat blends with adjacent fat).
